name: dray36
caption:
PICK 35 🎮🏀 34 players went before him. Now he's 36 and still runs our offense.

• 2012 draft: we take Draymond at #35, in the second round
• 4 titles: 2015, 2017, 2018, 2022
• 2017 Defensive Player of the Year
• First 8 games, all starts: 7.8 APG, 5.1 RPG, only 2.9 PPG

Still a starter at 36? 👇

beats.head: PICK 35
beats.name: DRAY
beats.vo: Thirty-four players got picked before him. We took Draymond Green in the second round.
beats.dlg: 34 GUYS GO BEFORE HIM.|WE TAKE DRAY AT 35.

beats.head: CHAMPION
beats.name: DRAY
beats.vo: Four championships. Defensive Player of the Year in twenty seventeen.

beats.head: AGE 36
beats.name: DRAY
beats.vo: Now he's thirty-six. Through eight games, he barely shoots: two point nine points a night. But seven point eight assists.

beats.head: STILL STARTING
beats.name: DRAY
beats.vo: Plus five rebounds, and he's started all eight games.

beats.head: STILL DRAY
beats.vo: Still a starter at thirty-six? Yes or no? Comment below.

facts.claim: Green was drafted 35th overall (2nd round) in 2012 by Golden State, so 34 players went before him; 4x champion (2015, 2017, 2018, 2022); 2017 Defensive Player of the Year; born March 4, 1990 (age 36)
